cells.tense: Clear thinking is showing up in your body right now, and you are with it.
cells.act: build the first new thing from what the clearing showed
cells.ask: Take what just came clear and put up a rough piece on it before the week turns — something you can point at when it's done. Keep it unpolished.
cells.core:
You can take a hard knot of thinking and lay out the route through it — not a lecture, a passage — and someone who couldn't see a way is walking it. The thinking is disciplined and it serves; it doesn't run the room.

When it's going well: you go quiet with a problem, come back with the way through it, and hand that over without needing credit for the trip. Here, something false has just come down and the open space pulls you toward explaining it. Better to put one rough piece on the cleared ground, small enough for your hands to finish and point at. What you build next grows out of what the clearing showed, not out of another round of talk. The room can hold a little less explaining.
cells.sheetLine: You find the way through, then someone else walks it.
cells.verb: putting what you know into words someone else can steer by

cells.tense: You will be three steps past what anyone with you can take in.
cells.act: engage the hard part on purpose and see what holds
cells.ask: Pick the stretch of this direction that's hardest to hold and stay there on purpose — no plan, no exit. What holds stays; what quits was the shape.
cells.core:
Where you give direction, you're braced against a future nobody can write yet, so you plan the whole crossing, then the next stretch, then the one past that, and the people meant to walk it are still on the bank. Direction this far out front stops being direction.

That same force, in order, moves at the pace of whoever is following, and solitude feeds the work instead of standing in for it. Staying in the difficult stretch is smaller than any new method: let the friction sort what you're committed to, and drop whatever shifts. What quits under that weight was the shape you'd given the thing, not the thing. Keep the purpose where it holds.
cells.sheetLine: You'll have planned the crossing before anyone boards.

cells.tense: You were the one who could see the passage, and you have gone quiet on it.
cells.act: return the small thing you owe before anyone asks
cells.ask: Return something you owe without being asked. Nobody has to see it happen, and no one has to agree it was owed.
cells.core:
You know where the passage is. You've been standing off to one side of it. Structures come down around you and you watch them go instead of saying what you see. Your thinking is as sharp as it ever was and none of it is being spent on anyone.

Pushing harder won't bring the direction back; force on a stopped thing just makes noise. What charges this is your own sense of what's right in a situation, acted on before checking with anybody — the fair thing nobody witnesses. Return what you owe and the clearer you is working again on a scale you can watch. From there the passage-finding comes back without being shoved.
cells.sheetLine: You know the passage and you've stopped saying so.

cells.tense: Right now you are setting the course, and the account of it has no author.
cells.act: join someone in the work so the two streams run as one
cells.ask: Bring one other person into a piece of work you'd steer by yourself — not to hand it off, to build it alongside you. Pick the piece where the wheel can be shared.
cells.core:
The sense of what's false and what's solid, the route past it — that's coming from you, and the story has you standing outside it. What your people steer by is being charted in real time and the chart is filed under nobody.

When this is flowing, the vision gets shared and then two people go on with it. Quitting here isn't effort; it's having a witness. Take a piece you'd normally carry alone and build it with one other, so the vision stops being a private broadcast and becomes something two people made. What gets charted after that stays charted, and it has a name on it.

attempts.check: Unsupported claim: that a clearing has happened or that the person is standing on cleared ground — the record says the seat is where false structure dissolves rapidly, not that it already has. A reader could reasonably say nothing has actually collapsed in their life and this is wishful framing. The asks survive being wrong because each is one small visible act on ground the person chooses, needing no safe person, no money, no spare energy; if the read is wrong, each still teaches them something. The sentence that serves me more than them, cut from the drafts: 'what you know needs to become what you share' — it flatters the writer's lineage and says nothing a person could use.
